raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #39274. Continues and rebases #40758 by @cs-fisha (same approach; see the delta below).

A literal `<｜deepseek_image｜>` typed or echoed by the user (quoting the token, pasting an error message that contains it, or a tool result that happens to include it) is hard-rejected with HTTP 400 by `_validate_no_image_sp_tokens`. Because most clients keep the failed turn in history, **every subsequent request in that conversation replays the poisoned message and is rejected too, permanently wedging the conversation**. Reproduced on `lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22` serving DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: any message role with the token in a string `content` gets the 400, while a proper `image_url` block works fine.

## Modifications

Same neutralize pattern as #40758 (and as the Kimi encoder): rewrite a user-supplied occurrence of the fullwidth-bar token to the ASCII-pipe spelling `<|deepseek_image|>` instead of raising. Genuine `image_url` blocks still insert the real placeholder, so the escaped spelling can never be confused with one downstream.

- Add `IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_ESCAPED` and `_escape_image_placeholder` in `encoding_dsv41.py`
- Rename `_validate_no_image_sp_tokens` → `_escape_image_sp_tokens`, rewriting the `content` / `reasoning_content` raise paths to escape in place
- Escape text blocks and string `tool_result` content in `_process_image_blocks` instead of raising

Delta vs #40758 (why a rebase was needed):

- #44751 added a **second call site** of `_validate_no_image_sp_tokens` in `encode_messages` (pre-merge pass, "escape before merging can discard message-level textual fields"). The rename in #40758 predates that commit: the patch still applies textually to current `main`, but the untouched new call site would hit a `NameError` on every request. This PR updates **both** call sites.
- The pre-merge pass now operates on deep copies so the caller's message objects are never mutated (escaping rewrites `content`/`reasoning_content` in place).

## Accuracy Tests

CPU unit tests in `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_encoding_dsv41.py`:

- The five cases from #40758: tool-result string, user text block, string `content`, `reasoning_content`, plus a control that a genuine `image_url` block still inserts the real placeholder and yields one image record
- New: `context` messages containing the token no longer raise (covers the pre-merge pass added by #44751)
- New: the caller's `messages` are not mutated by the escape pass

All previously-accepted requests encode byte-identically; only requests that used to fail with the 400 change behavior (they now render with the escaped spelling).

```
PYTHONPATH=python python3 -m unittest discover -s test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai -p 'test_encoding_dsv41.py' -v
ruff format --check / ruff check --select=F401,F821,F823,UP037 / isort on the touched files: clean
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable — encoding-only change; the extra work is one substring scan per string field (same order as the previous validation scan it replaces).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to the [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to the [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidelines](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

---

Note for maintainers: if you'd rather land #40758 directly, this branch can serve as the rebase reference (the `NameError` fix for the #44751 call site is the one blocking change it needs). Either PR works — happy to close whichever you prefer. The fork PR needs the `run-ci` label to run CI.

+"""Unit tests for the DeepSeek-V4.1 chat encoder -- no server, no model loading."""
+
+import copy
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.encoding_dsv41 import (
+    IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER,
+    IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_ESCAPED,
+    encode_messages,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestImagePlaceholderEscaping(CustomTestCase):
+    """A literal '<｜deepseek_image｜>' typed by the user must never be mistaken
+    for a real image placeholder: it is escaped to the ASCII-pipe spelling
+    instead of being rejected, and it must never produce an image token.
+    """
+
+    def test_tool_result_literal_placeholder_is_escaped_not_rejected(self):
+        messages = [
+            {"role": "user", "content": "question"},
+            {
+                "role": "assistant",
+                "content": "calling tool",
+                "tool_calls": [
+                    {
+                        "id": "a",
+                        "type": "function",
+                        "function": {"name": "lookup", "arguments": {"query": "q"}},
+                    }
+                ],
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "tool",
+                "tool_call_id": "a",
+                "content": f"result mentions {IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER} literally",
+            },
+        ]
+        prompt, mm = encode_messages(
+            messages, thinking_mode="chat", return_multi_modal_data=True
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(mm["images"], [])
+        self.assertNotIn(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER, prompt)
+        self.assertIn(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_ESCAPED, prompt)
+
+    def test_user_text_literal_placeholder_is_escaped_not_rejected(self):
+        messages = [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": f"please explain {IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER}"}
+                ],
+            },
+        ]
+        prompt, mm = encode_messages(
+            messages, thinking_mode="chat", return_multi_modal_data=True
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(mm["images"], [])
+        self.assertNotIn(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER, prompt)
+        self.assertIn(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_ESCAPED, prompt)
+
+    def test_string_content_literal_placeholder_is_escaped_not_rejected(self):
+        messages = [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": f"What does the token {IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER} mean?",
+            },
+        ]
+        prompt, mm = encode_messages(
+            messages, thinking_mode="thinking", return_multi_modal_data=True
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(mm["images"], [])
+        self.assertNotIn(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER, prompt)
+        self.assertIn(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_ESCAPED, prompt)
+
+    def test_reasoning_content_literal_placeholder_is_escaped(self):
+        messages = [
+            {"role": "user", "content": "question"},
+            {
+                "role": "assistant",
+                "reasoning_content": f"thinking about {IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER}",
+                "content": "answer",
+            },
+        ]
+        prompt = encode_messages(
+            messages, thinking_mode="thinking", drop_thinking=False
+        )
+        self.assertNotIn(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER, prompt)
+        self.assertIn(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_ESCAPED, prompt)
+
+    def test_context_messages_literal_placeholder_does_not_raise(self):
+        """The pre-merge escape pass added for #44751 must cover ``context``
+        messages too: a literal token there used to raise, now it is escaped
+        (context is not rendered into the prompt, but must not 400).
+        """
+        context = [
+            {"role": "user", "content": f"earlier turn said {IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER}"},
+            {"role": "assistant", "content": "earlier answer"},
+        ]
+        messages = [{"role": "user", "content": "follow-up"}]
+        prompt = encode_messages(messages, thinking_mode="chat", context=context)
+        self.assertNotIn(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER, prompt)
+        self.assertIn("follow-up", prompt)
+
+    def test_caller_messages_are_not_mutated(self):
+        """Escaping happens on internal copies; the caller's message objects
+        keep the literal token so request-derived state stays untouched.
+        """
+        messages = [
+            {"role": "user", "content": f"echo {IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER} back"},
+            {"role": "assistant", "content": "ok"},
+            {"role": "user", "content": "again"},
+        ]
+        original = copy.deepcopy(messages)
+        encode_messages(messages, thinking_mode="chat")
+        self.assertEqual(messages, original)
+
+    def test_real_image_block_still_inserts_the_actual_placeholder(self):
+        messages = [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "image_url",
+                        "image_url": {"url": "https://example.com/cat.png"},
+                    },
+                    {"type": "text", "text": "what is this?"},
+                ],
+            },
+        ]
+        prompt, mm = encode_messages(
+            messages, thinking_mode="chat", return_multi_modal_data=True
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(len(mm["images"]), 1)
+        self.assertIn(IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER, prompt)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
